editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood gem honoring its predecessor with authentic Mexican cooking that doesn't cut corners—from housemade tortillas to perfectly seasoned carne asada and tender shrimp.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or prepare for a wait on weekends; ask your server for the matcha hot sauce if you prefer extra heat, and don't skip the complimentary taco de papa con huevo that arrives at your table.
